questions.question: Why does the effective nuclear charge experienced by valence electrons decrease down the group?

options.text: The outermost electrons are closest to the nucleus
innermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus
outermost electrons are farther away from the nucleus

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __the outermost electrons are further away from the nucleus.____ __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __key points__

__
 
• Down the group, the effective nuclear charge experienced by the valence electrons decreases as the outermost electrons move further away from the nucleus .
 
• These electrons can be easily lost. 
 
• Thus, the metallic property decreases in a period and moves down the group.
 
• The effective nuclear charge increases in period from left to right as the table unfolds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• The word "effective" is used because shielding effect The negatively charged electron prevents the higher energy electrons from experiencing the full nuclear charge of the nucleus due to the repulsive effect of the inner layer. 
 
• The effective nuclear charge experienced by an electron is also called the core charge.
 
• A higher effective nuclear charge causes greater attraction for electrons, pulling the electron cloud closer to the nucleus resulting in a smaller atomic radius.

questions.question: The systematic name of which compound is nitrogen trihydride that is widely used in many industrial processes, and as a fertiliser and refrigerant?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Ammonia.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ammonia** is used in many industrial processes, and as a fertilizer and refrigerant.
 
• **Ammonia** is a colorless, pungent, suffocating, highly water-soluble, gaseous compound, usually produced by the direct combination of nitrogen and hydrogen.
 
• It is used chiefly for **refrigeration**, and in the manufacturing of chemicals.
 
• Ammonia is a compound with the molecular formula of** NH3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Potash**__ is used **primarily in fertilizers (approximately 95%)** to support plant growth**, ****increase crop yield and disease resistance, and enhance water preservation.**
 
• __**Urea**__ has important uses as a **fertilizer and feed supplement,** as well as a starting material for the manufacture of** plastics and drugs**.
 
• It is a colorless, crystalline substance that melts at 132.7° C (271° F) and decomposes before boiling.
 
• __**Phosphine**__ is **used in the semiconductor industry to introduce phosphorus into silicon crystals** . 
 
• It is also used as a** fumigant, a polymerization initiator** and as an intermediate for the preparation of several flame retardants.

questions.question: Who arranged the elements with chemically similar properties, such as lithium, sodium, and potassium, and showed that the properties of the middle element could be predicted from the properties of the other two?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Johann Dobereiner**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Dobereiner **stated in his **law of triads **that **the arithmetic means of the atomic masses **of the **first and third element **in **a triad **would be **approximately equal **to **the atomic mass **of the **second element **in **that triad**.
 
• Also, when **elements are arranged **in **order of increasing atomic masses**, **groups of three elements(triads**), having **similar chemical properties **are obtained.
 
• The main **Limitation of Dobereiner's classification **of **elements was **that he **failed to arrange **all the **then-known elements in the form of triads **of elements having **similar chemical properties**.
 
• The **first of Dobereiner's triads **was **identified **in the **year 1817 **and was **constituted by **the **alkaline earth metals calcium, strontium, and barium.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lother Meyer **was the **first person **to recognize the **periodic trends **in **the properties of elements**, and **the graph **shows the **pattern **he saw in the **atomic volume **of an **element plotted **against its **atomic weight**.
 
• **John Newlands **was the **first to arrange **the **elements **into a **periodic table **with **increasing order **of **atomic masses**.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev **devised the periodic classification of the **chemical elements**, in which the **elements **were **arranged **in **order of increasing atomic weight**.

questions.question: Which element of Group 13 of the periodic table liquefies just above room temperature?
questions.solution:
The correct option is __**Gallium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Group 13 elements are also known as **Boron Family.**
 
• The **elements are Boron, Aluminium, Gallium, Indium, Thallium.**
 
• The general** electronic configuration** for the group 13 elements is ns2 np1.
 
• Gallium was discovered in 1875 by French chemist Paul-Émile Lecoq de Boisbaudran.
 
• Atomic number of **Gallium** is 31 and chemical symbol is **Ga.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Boron** is the lightest element of Boron family, the chemical symbol **B** and atomic number is 5. In its crystalline form it is a brittle, dark, lustrous metalloid; in its amorphus form it is a brown powder.
 
• **Aluminium's** chemical symbol **Al** and atomic number 13. It has a density lower than those of other common metals.
 
• **Thallium **is a chemical element with the symbol **Tl** and atomic number 81. It is a gray post-transition metal that is not found free in nature.
 
• **Indium** is a chemical element with the symbol **In** and atomic number 49. Indium is the softest metal that is not an alkali metal. It is a silvery-white metal that resembles Tin in appearance. It is a post-transition metal that makes up 0.21 parts per million of the Earth's crust.

questions.question: Where is sodium located on the periodic table?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**On the left side**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sodium is located on the **left side of the periodic table in the first group**.
 
• Sodium, atomic symbol** Na**, has an atomic number of** eleven, **and lies in** group 1 on the periodic table, **below** lithium **and to the** left of magnesium. **
 
• This element is in the **alkali metals family**, and it has only** one valence electron**.
 
• Sodium is** used as a heat exchanger** in some** nuclear reactors, **and as a **reagent** in the chemicals industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The periodic table is a tabular array of the chemical elements organized by atomic number, from the element with the lowest atomic number, hydrogen, to the element with the highest atomic number.
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev** is the father of the periodic table.
 
• The **Modern Periodic Table **that we use was developed by **Henry Moseley**.
 
• In a periodic table elements are arranged in **columns, known as groups, and rows, called periods.**
 
• There are a total of 4 blocks in the periodic table named **s,p,d,f.**
 
• **S block** contains groups **1 (alkali metals) and 2 (alkaline earth metals**) elements.
 
• **P block **elements are found in periodic table groups **(13-18).**
 
• **D block** contains elements from groups **(3 to 12)**.
 
• **F block** contains **14 elements named Lanthanoides after (Lanthanum) La (57) and 14 elements called Actinoides after (Actinium) Ac (89).**

questions.question: Which of the following is the allotropic form of carbon?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** __Graphite__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Graphite is the allotropic form of carbon.**
 
• Graphite, archaically referred to** as plumbago, **is a crystalline form of the element carbon with its atoms arranged in a hexagonal structure. 
 
• There are various allotropes of carbon:
 
 
• **diamond, graphite, lonsdaleite, fullerene, C-540, C-70, amorphous carbon, carbon nanotube**.
 
 
 
• **Diamond and crystalline silicon are isomorphous** because they both have a **three-dimensional tetrahedral structure.**
 
• Allotropy, the existence of **a chemical element in two or more forms, which may differ in the arrangement of atoms in crystalline solids** or in the occurrence of molecules that contain different numbers of atoms.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Coal :**

 
 
• Coal is **a form of amorphous carbon, which is formed by pyrolysis**.

 
 
• **It is an impure form of carbon. **
 
 
 
 
 
• Charcoal is also an allotrope of carbon that is formed by the process of pyrolysis.
 
• **Diamond :**
 
 
• Diamond and fullerene are **pure forms of carbon.**
 
• Diamond is** a solid form of the element carbon with its atoms arranged in a crystal structure called diamond cubic.**
 
 
 
• **Lamp Black :**
 
 
• Lampblack is **a simple genuine pigment made of carbon black.**
 
• The pure carbon pigment is made from the residual soot from burning oil and its name comes from the practice of making it with oil lamps.
 
• Older and less stable blacks made from oil also existed and were called oil black or flame black.

questions.question: Identify the word that means horizontal rows in periodic table.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Periods.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** A period **in the **periodic table **is a **row of chemical elements**. It is the **horizontal line **in the **periodic table**. **The periodic table **is **divided **into **seven periods (1-7).**
 
• **A group **is **a column **of **elements **in the **periodic table **of the **chemical elements**. There are **18 numbered groups **in the **periodic table**.
 
• **Orbitals **are the **mathematical expressions **of **electrons **that **describe **the **electron's property**. Any element can have **max 4 orbitals(S.p.d.f).**
 
• **A valence electron **is an **electron **in the **outer shell **associated with **an atom**, and that can **participate **in the **formation **of a **chemical bond.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Periodic table**, also known as the **periodic table **of the **(chemical) elements**, is a **tabular display **of the **chemical elements**. 
 
• **Periodic table **is based on the **modern periodic law **which states that **the properties of the chemical elements exhibit a periodic dependence on their atomic numbers.**
 
• **Modern periodic table **is **made **by **Russian chemist Dmitri Mendeleev **in **1869**.

questions.question: Identify the chemical name for Ge.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Germanium.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Germanium** is a chemical element with the symbol **Ge **and** atomic number 32.**
 
• It is a lustrous, hard-brittle, grayish-white metalloid in the carbon group, chemically similar to its group neighbors **silicon and tin**.
 
• Pure germanium is a semiconductor with an appearance similar to elemental silicon.
 
• **Germanium atom forms four covalent bonds with the four neighboring atoms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gallium is a chemical element with the symbol Ga and atomic number 31.
 
• Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au and atomic number 79, making it one of the higher atomic number elements that occur naturally. 
 
• Gadolinium is a chemical element with the symbol Gd and atomic number 64. Gadolinium is a silvery-white metal when oxidation is removed. 
 
• **Covalent Bond:__**
 __
 
• **​__T****he interatomic linkage that results from the sharing of an electron pair between two atoms**. 
 
• The binding arises from the electrostatic attraction of their nuclei for the same electrons.
 
• **Example**: **Water (H₂O)** A water molecule consists of two hydrogens and one oxygen (O) atom. Oxygen has a valency of two, and hydrogen has only one electron in its orbital. So, each hydrogen atom will share its electron and covalently bond with the oxygen.

questions.question: Which compound has the chemical formula CHCl₃ whose melting point is 209 K?

The correct answer is__** Chloroform.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Chloroform, or trichloromethane, is an **organic compound** with the formula CHCl3. 
 
• It is a **colourless, strong-smelling**, dense liquid that is produced on a large scale as a precursor to** PTFE**. 
 
• It is also a precursor to various refrigerants. It is one of the four chloromethanes and a trihalomethane.
 
• Chloroform is used **as a solvent, a substance that helps other substances dissolve**.
 
• Also, it is used in the building, paper, and board industries, and in **pesticide and film production.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Carbon tetrachloride chemical structure. CCl4 is **a clear, nonflammable, heavy liquid that evaporates readily, producing a sweet characteristic odour similar to chloroform.**​ 
 
• A chlorophenol is any organochloride of phenol that contains one or more covalently bonded chlorine atoms.
 
• 2-Chloroethanol is primarily used for the **synthesis of ethylene oxide and a number of synthetic reactions for the preparation of dyes, pharmaceuticals, biocides, and plasticizers**.
 
• It is also used for the **manufacture of thiodiglycol.**

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct regarding mixtures?

options.text: Colloids are heterogeneous mixtures in which the particle size is large.
The major component of a solution is called the solvent.
The minor component of a solution is called the solute.
A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Colloids are heterogeneous mixtures in which the particle size is large **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A mixture is a combination of two or more substances that are not chemically bonded to each other.
 
• Mixtures can be classified into two types: homogeneous and heterogeneous.
 
• Homogeneous mixtures have a uniform composition throughout, whereas heterogeneous mixtures have a non-uniform composition.
 
• The components of a mixture can be separated by physical methods such as filtration, distillation, chromatography, etc.
 
• Filtration is used to separate a solid from a liquid or a gas.
 
• Distillation is used to separate a mixture of two or more liquids with different boiling points.
 
• **Colloids**, also known as colloidal solutions or colloidal systems, are mixtures in which microscopically dispersed insoluble particles of one substance are suspended in another substance. 
 
• The size of the suspended particles in a colloid can range from 1 to 1000 nanometres (10-9 meters) which is **very small**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Solution **

 
• A solution is a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances, where one substance is called the solute and the other is called the solvent.
 
• The solute is the substance that is dissolved in the solvent, whereas the solvent is the substance in which the solute is dissolved.
 
• Solutions can be classified as solid, liquid, or gaseous, depending on the physical state of the solvent.
 
• The concentration of a solution is the amount of solute present in a given amount of solvent or solution.

questions.question: Which of the following gases is referred to as ‘laughing gas’ ?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrous Oxide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nitrous oxide** is a colorless and odorless substance that's also known as “**laughing gas**.”
 
• It is an oxide of nitrogen with the formula **N₂O**.
 
• When inhaled, the gas slows down the body's reaction time. This results in a calm, euphoric feeling. Nitrous** **oxide can be used to treat pain.
 
• It also functions as a mild sedative. Because of this, it’s sometimes used before dental procedures to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety.
 
• **Side Effects**:
 
 
• Some people also experience hallucinations or sound distortion after inhaling nitrous oxide.
 
• Toxic exposure may lead to a **V****itamin B-12** deficiency or anemia.

questions.question: Which inorganic compound is used to manufacture soap, rayon, paper, explosives, dyes, and petroleum products?

questions.question: Alkali metals react vigorously with cold water resulting in the displacement of ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**hydrogen**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__** 

 
• **Alkali Metals:**

 
 
• Alkali metals react vigorously with cold water resulting in the displacement of hydrogen.
 
• **Hydrogen (H), lithium (Li), sodium (Na), potassium (K), rubidium (Rb), caesium (Cs), and francium (Fr)** are called alkali metals.
 
• Alkali metals are soft, shiny, low-melting, highly reactive metals, which tarnish when exposed to air. 
 
• Alkali metals are very reactive, they are found in their elemental form in nature, and are usually found as ionic compounds (except for hydrogen).
 
• They have only one valence electron in the highest-energy orbitals (ns1). 
 
• They have low melting points.
 
• These elements react vigorously with water and produce metal hydroxide, hydrogen gas, and heat.

questions.question: Which scientist arranged the Periodic Table of Elements in the order of increasing atomic masses?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Dmitri Mendeleev**__.

__
 
• **Dmitri Mendeleev** arranged the Periodic Table of Elements in the order of increasing atomic masses.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Father of the Periodic Table is Mendeleev.
 
• Mendeleev’s Periodic Table (1869)
 
 
• It is based upon the Mendeleev’s periodic law, which states, “**Properties of the elements are the periodic function of their atomic masses**.”
 
• Modern Periodic Law: **Modern periodic law was given by Moseley. **
 
• According to Moseley: “The physical and chemical properties of the elements are the periodic function of their **atomic numbers**.”
 
 
 
• **Modern Periodic Table**:
 
 
• It is just a graphical representation of** the Aufbau configuration of elements **and contains **118 elements.**
 
• Modern periodic table is classified as:
 
 
• s-block;
 
• p-block;
 
• d-block;
 
• f-block.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Boyle’s Law states that at a constant temperature, the volume of a definite mass of a gas is inversely proportional to pressure.
 
• **William Ramsay **was a Scottish chemist who discovered the noble gases and received the **Nobel Prize in Chemistry in 1904.**

questions.question: Which one of the following pair is an example of Isobars?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Calcium and argon__.

__**Explanation:**__

__
 
• **Calcium and argon are examples of a pair of Isobars**__. Calcium and argon have a mass number of 40. The atomic number of argon 18 and an atomic number of calcium is 20.
 
• Isobars:
 __
 
• These are atoms of the elements having the **same mass number but different atomic numbers**.
 
• They differ in the chemical property but has the same physical property.
 
• Example: argon, potassium and calcium.
 
 
 
• The mass number is the sum of a number of protons and neutrons in an atom of the elements is called the mass number.
 
 
• It is denoted by A.
 
 
 
• The atomic number is the number of proton or electrons in an atom of the element is called the atomic number.
 
 
• It is denoted by Z.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Isotopes: These are atoms of the elements having the same atomic number but a different mass number.

 
 
• The isotopes of hydrogen are Protium, Deuterium and Tritium
 
 
 
• Isotones: These are atoms of different elements having the same number of neutrons.
 
• Isoelectronic: These are atoms/molecules/ ions containing the same number of electrons.
